added.summary: The new default for RenderSettings.upscaler and the medium preset: FSR 3.1 while the scene is drawn below render scale 1 (automatic quality's included), TAAU at render scale 1. A game that never set the upscaler now upscales with FSR 3.1 whenever its render scale drops, which keeps thin geometry and moving detail that TAAU lost, for about 1 to 2 ms more GPU time at 1080p and 1440p on an M4 Pro. At render scale 1, and on every native run, the frame is TAAU's as before. Set upscaler taau to keep TAAU at every scale; the low preset does.

fixed.summary: Lists fsr3 only where the device has compute: on the gl tier it listed fsr3 although the frame was resolved with TAAU.
